description: Four trigger tracks of four rows each, the rows of a track sharing one output and one colour

params.text: Sets how many columns play before the sequence starts over
Sets the direction the sequence travels through its columns
Turns every cell in the grid off
Clears the grid and fills it with random cells
Sets how full the grid is left after a randomise
Moves the column the sequence starts from

inputs.text: Each trigger here advances the sequence by one column
A trigger here sends the sequence back to its first column
Clears the grid and fills it with random cells
Sets how many columns play before the sequence starts over
Moves the column the sequence starts from
Sets the direction the sequence travels through its columns
A voltage here seeds the random number generator, so the same voltage always gives the same result from a randomise

outputs.text: A trigger whenever a cell of that colour is on in the column now playing
A trigger at the end of each pass through the sequence
A trigger whenever any of the four tracks fires
A trigger whenever exactly one of the four tracks fires
A trigger whenever none of the four tracks fires

notes: click a cell in the grid to turn it on or off, and drag across the grid to paint a run of them
menu: Repeat First Row Down — copies the first row of each track into the other three rows of that track
Gate Length — sets how long the output triggers last, in milliseconds
